description: This file contains unit tests for the NameTemplate class in the OpenMRS project. It tests formatting of person names using different templates and configurations.

classes.name: NameTemplateTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing name formatting functionality within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the NameSupport instance and configures special tokens before each test.

methods.name: shouldProperlyFormatName
methods.description: Tests formatting of a PersonName object to a single line with givenName and familyName.

methods.name: shouldProperlyFormatNameWithNonTokens
methods.description: Tests formatting of a PersonName object including middleName and custom formatting rules with special characters.

methods.name: shouldUseNameTemplateConfiguredViaGlobalProperties
methods.description: Tests name formatting based on global property configurations, simulating dynamic configuration changes.
